newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares edge up in a light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares edge up in a light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares edged up in light trade on Tuesday, led by second largest bank Hermis Bank, dealers said.
Central market volume was 827,000 litas and the group A index which tracks the central market's 36 most active listings rose by 35.75 points to 1,411.64.
Hermis Bank was the most active listing as its price rose to 143 litas from 142 amid trade of 538,395 litas.
Market leader Vilnius Bankas has been quiet lately as it prepares a share split, expected to be approved by the central bank on Thursday. Bloc trades on Tuesday reached 123,000 litas.
